metadata.description: A complete Claude Code toolkit — skills, agents and commands for Laravel developers, solo founders and package authors.

plugins.name: claude-toolkit
plugins.description: 38 skills, 23 role agents and 12 commands covering Laravel, TypeScript, Go and Python development, testing, debugging, code quality, performance, accessibility, security hardening, CI/CD, deployment, package development, documentation, requirements, sales, branding and support operations. Kickoff-baseline aware. Ships graphify and ponytail as companions and a TLDR+table output default.
